title: Are Large Language Models Effective Knowledge Graph Constructors?
abstract: arXiv:2510.11297v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are widely used in knowledge-intensive applications, yet it remains unclear how effectively current large language models (LLMs) can construct document-grounded KGs in a zero-shot, schema-free setting without relying on complex task-specific frameworks. We introduce Detail-to-Abstract Hierarchical Knowledge Graph (D2A-HKG) construction framework, which decomposes KG construction into three stages: initial extraction, splitting, and abstraction, and evaluates the resulting graphs from both semantic and structural perspectives. Using seven frontier LLMs, we benchmark zero-shot KG construction on CMW-Lit, a dataset derived from published paediatric research articles on children's mental well-being. CMW-Lit provides a challenging test bed due to its heterogeneous evidence, interconnected factors, and complex, statistically qualified relationships. translated_title: 大型语言模型是有效的知识图谱构建器吗？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.11297v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：知识图谱（KGs）广泛用于知识密集型应用，但目前尚不清楚当前大型语言模型（LLMs）在零样本、无模式设置下，不依赖复杂任务特定框架时，能否有效构建文档为基础的知识图谱。我们引入了从细节到抽象的层次化知识图谱（D2A-HKG）构建框架，该框架将知识图谱构建分解为三个步骤：初始提取、拆分和抽象，并从语义和结构两个角度评估生成的图谱。使用七个前沿LLMs，我们在CMW-Lit数据集上对零样本知识图谱构建进行了基准测试，该数据集源自关于儿童心理健康的已发表儿科研究文章。CMW-Lit因其异质证据、相互关联的因素和复杂的统计限定关系而提供了具有挑战性的测试平台。我们的结果显示，最先进的LLMs通常能产生合理的图谱结构，但在处理复杂关系时存在局限性。
tldr: 本文提出D2A-HKG框架，评估了七个LLM在零样本无模式条件下构建文档知识图谱的能力，发现它们能生成合理结构但在复杂关系处理上不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the D2A-HKG framework, evaluating seven LLMs' zero-shot schema-free KG construction, finding they produce reasonable structures but struggle with complex relations.
